lastfm.bio: Liars is an experimental electro/rock band formed in 2000. Australian-born Angus Andrew is the founding and only constant member, with Aaron Hemphill (percussion, guitar, synth) leaving the project in 2017 and Julian Gross (drums) being no longer able to perform due to personal reasons.
